title: How sure are we? Covariance, gating and fusion
summary: Turn a cloud of fixes into a covariance and an error ellipse, learn the χ² law by simulation, carry a covariance through a function with J P Jᵀ, judge and attack a χ² gate after a GPS outage, fuse GPS with day vision by their information — and measure when fusion hurts. You write NAVERA Lite's uncertainty part on top of mission 12's position contract.
